blocks.text: Yeh chhote molecules hain jo ek hi amino acid (aam taur par tyrosine ya tryptophan) se bante hain. Yeh cell membrane ke paar ja sakte hain ya nahin, is ka faisla is par hai ke yeh protein jaisa bartao karte hain ya lipid (charbi) jaisa. Epinephrine aur norepinephrine membrane ke paar nahin ja sakte, jabke thyroxine aur tri-iodothyronine ja sakte hain. Misalein:

blocks.title: Tidbit: pehla hormone kaise mila
blocks.text: 1902 mein do British scientists, Bayliss aur Starling, digestive system (hazme ka nizam) par tehqeeq kar rahe the ke unhon ne hormone daryaft kiya. Unhon ne dekha ke jab tezabi (acidic) gastric juice chhoti aant mein aata hai to ek madda khoon mein chhoot'ta hai, jise unhon ne “secretin” ka naam diya. Secretin pancreas tak pohanch kar use pancreatic juice chhorne par uksata hai.

blocks.caption: Amino acid derivatives hormones
rows: Fauri “fight or flight” (lado ya bhago) jawab.
Blood pressure aur chaukanna-pan (alertness) barhata hai.
Metabolism ki raftar qaboo karta hai.
Jism ka darja-e-hararat (temperature) aur dil ki dharkan qaboo karta hai.
